terms_check: All 16 quoted terms appear verbatim on their live sources: AWS registry 3, NCEI product page 3, readme.txt 6, readme-by_station 1, status-by_station 1, NSIDC G02158 2 (after following a redirect). Licence: the AWS CC0 sentence describes the NODD copy only, and the NCEI product page has no licence wording. The licence basis for NOAA and federal records is NCEI-PD-10-2-02 section 4(a), which I read live: NOAA and federal environmental data 'are in the public domain in the United States', and NCEI will work to apply CC0. For CoCoRaHS (non-federal, section 4(c)), the live CoCoRaHS Data Usage Policy says its data are released under CC BY 3.0 and asks users to acknowledge the source. So the record's CC0 statement is right for COOP, SNOTEL and WBAN and wrong for CoCoRaHS.

Evidence: all 114 Montana S3 by-station csv files for SNOTEL (89) and WBAN (25) are dated 9 Feb 2025, and the two checked for content end on 6 Feb 2025; all 481 NCEI .dly files are dated 18 Oct 2026 and end 14 to 16 Oct 2026.
